author: ULTIMATE7FALCON
body:
Prysalus CTW is a map that was originally made by myself and Hoodovah as an OCN/Lifeboat tournament map. Due to the downfall of  Lifeboat it never had a  chance to get tested.  I totally forgot about the map until I saw Dev_revs map making contest. And now I'm excited to finally be bringing it to Avicus!

replies.author: ULTIMATE7FALCON
replies.body:
The spawn is by the island with the gold, with 2 wools one ahead and to the right of the spawn and one off to the left. The middle from top to bottom consists of an island with a gapple spawner, a raised island with an arrow spawner, and the bridge section.
Hope that helps :)
